name: Epistolary/Narrative Khipu Corpus
notes: Gary Urton (Signs of the Inka Khipu, University of Texas Press, 2003) argues khipu construction encodes binary-coded information beyond pure accounting. Newer analyzed cords with up to 95 distinct symbols (within logosyllabic range) and Zipf/Shannon-entropy statistical signatures consistent with natural-language structure have been reported, but no confirmed reading of narrative content exists. Mainstream caution holds most khipu are confidently readable only as numerical/accounting records — genuinely DISPUTED, not resolved either direction.
